programs.description: A youngster from village rises to fame after winning a singing reality show but soon, he has to deal with alcoholism and heartbreak.
The life of four friends changes when one of them decides to start a business in funeral management with an innovative idea to conduct the last rituals.
A city-bred bubbly girl yearns for the love of her self-involved parents and falls sick. Soon, she finds solace at a shepherd's home in a village and recovers but hesitates to go back to the city.
